publicReleaseNotes: Terrace can be hosted without outbound email. Owners sign in with rer signin. The Base agent door authenticates MCP discovery, negotiates MCP versions, renews signed policy, and stops Business access after detachment.
agentUpdateInstructions: Back up and exercise a restored copy before adopting. Install the frozen dependencies with RER CLI 0.2.144, then run the normal deployment update to apply migration 0118_agent_door_relay.sql. For outbound email, supply MAIL_PROVIDER and MAIL_FROM again when coming from 0.1.5 because they were plain settings. The existing MAIL_API_KEY secret is inherited. With MAIL_PROVIDER=none, leave mail credentials unset and run rer signin in the deployment checkout. The new Business relay begins with new decisions; existing audit rows remain in the local audit. See OPERATIONS.md to turn mail off on a deployment that already has mail.
